test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following will NOT be included in the estimation of national income?

(i) Expenses on electricity by a factory

(ii) Financial help to earthquake victims

(iii) Imputed value of production for self-consumption

(iv) Brokerage on sale of bonds
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (ii) and (iv)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Expenses on electricity by a factory** – Counted indirectly through **value added**, so **included**.
